answers.core:
It's totally possible to make a plugin which can provide aliases and various other utility methods for manipulating core data structures, like with [`VectorResource` plugin](https://github.com/Xrayez/godot-vector-resource).

As for me, just renaming `Rect2` to `Rect` would also be enough to resolve this proposal as I'm mostly working with 2D projects personally, yet it would be wrong not to do a similar treatment for `AABB`, because the issue is likely with lack of consistency here, as seen in #1528.
answers.workaround: Certainly, just use current names, there's no way around it.

title: Rename `Rect2` to `Rect` (and considerations regarding consistency with `AABB` name in 3D)
